[id 40]
Suzy's iPhone is 1 year old.
Ben's iPhone is twice as old as Suzy's: $1 \times 2 = 2$ years.
Brandon's iPhone is four times as old as Ben's: $2 \times 4 = 8$ years.

[id 41]
Normal throw distance = 400 feet.
With sapphire, distance is 3 times normal: $400 \times 3 = 1200$ feet.
Dragon's fire range = 1000 feet.
Distance outside the fire range = $1200 - 1000 = 200$ feet.

[id 42]
Total pieces = 5 pies $\times$ 8 pieces/pie = 40 pieces.
Remaining pieces = 14.
Pieces taken = $40 - 14 = 26$.

[id 43]
Remaining calories = $2000 - 1800 = 200$ calories.
One serving = 250 calories.
Total weight of bag = 300 grams for 5 servings.
Weight per serving = $300 / 5 = 60$ grams.
Calories per gram = $250 / 60 = 25/6$.
Grams allowed = $200 / (25/6) = 200 \times 6 / 25 = 8 \times 6 = 48$ grams.

[id 44]
10 candles cost $10.00 to make.
To make 20 candles, cost = $10.00 \times 2 = \$20.00$.
Revenue from 20 candles = $20 \times \$2.00 = \$40.00$.
Profit = $\$40.00 - \$20.00 = \$20.00$.

[id 45]
Monday: 5 articles.
Tuesday: $5 + (2/5 \times 5) = 5 + 2 = 7$ articles.
Wednesday: $7 \times 2 = 14$ articles.
Total articles = $5 + 7 + 14 = 26$ articles.
Total time = $26 \text{ articles} \times 4 \text{ hours/article} = 104$ hours.

[id 46]
Let $x$ be the number of notes in the new packet.
Total notes = $80 + x$.
Notes used = 220.
Remaining = $(80 + x) - 220 = 23$.
$x - 140 = 23 \Rightarrow x = 163$.

[id 47]
Cost of blue tie = $40.
Number of blue ties = $\$200 / \$40 = 5$ blue ties.
Red ties = $2 \times 5 = 10$ red ties.
Price of red tie = $40 \times 1.5 = \$60$.
Total cost = $(5 \times 40) + (10 \times 60) = 200 + 600 = 800$.

[id 48]
Total length = 4 feet.
Piece length = 6 inches = 0.5 feet.
Number of pieces = $4 / 0.5 = 8$.

[id 49]
Total units = $15 \times 8 = 120$.
Occupied units = $120 \times 3/4 = 90$.
Unoccupied units = $120 - 90 = 30$.
